notes.title: ZHEROS Original Soundtrack
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
We're happy to share with you the release of the ZHEROS official soundtrack.
We put together 12 tracks composed by Giovanni Leon Dall'Ò for the game.
A total of around 60 minutes of music that you can now listen to whenever you like!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/444540/

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Added option to reduce camera shake
- It's now possible to select the in-game language from the Steam game properties
- Fixed language not showing correctly in game for some users

notes.title: ZHEROS Now Available
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

We’re really excited that ZHEROS is finally available for release, and we can’t wait to hear what you all think. Thank you all, grab your copy and enjoy some punching ːsteamhappyː
